parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The IDs of ENS nodes. Array length: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: HaVipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the HaVip instance.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the HaVip instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings for paging.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The HaVip status. Valid values:
- Creating: The HaVip is being created.
- Available: The HaVip is available.
- InUse: The HaVip is in use.
- Deleting: The HaVip is being deleted.
